name: Tsang Wai-lam
bio: Ferry mechanic on the night crossing, and sells only the loud dreams.

name: Marisol Vega
bio: Line cook who naps between shifts and wakes up with the city still running.

name: Thandiwe Mokoena
bio: Climbing guide, and every listing here involves height in some form.

name: Ari Whitcombe
bio: Keeps bees on the plains and records almost everything outdoors.

name: June Park
bio: Bridge painter, and the catalogue is mostly birds and weather.

name: Rui Bettencourt
bio: Sold a company once and has been sleeping badly ever since.

name: Camila Ferreyra
bio: Works a fire lookout eight months a year, alone, above the treeline.

name: Niamh Sutherland
bio: Night porter in an old hotel, and refuses to sell anything recorded twice.

name: Elio Marchetti
bio: Retired ferry captain who naps at noon and lists whatever comes of it.
